stored_text.note: official.html is the National Legislation Database (njt.jog.gov.hu) page with the full Hungarian text, preamble, §§ 1-15 and footnotes (adoption 21 Oct 2025, promulgation 31 Oct 2025). document-1.pdf is the wrong document: it is the njt site's accessibility statement (Akadálymentesítési nyilatkozat, MKIFK), not related to the Act; the same PDF is stored for HU-02.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. The njt site has a 'Translated legislation' section (/translations), but one web search found no English translation of this Act there or elsewhere from a public body; only law-firm and tracker summaries.

title.source_quote:
2025. évi LXXV. törvény
az Európai Unió mesterséges intelligenciáról szóló rendeletének magyarországi végrehajtásáról
title.why: original_title matches the page heading exactly (the source appends footnote marker 1). The English title is a literal rendering.

summary_claims.claim: a government-designated AI notifying authority, which assesses, designates, notifies and monitors conformity assessment bodies for high-risk systems
summary_claims.original_quote: megfelelőségértékelő szervezeteket az MI bejelentő hatóság – akkreditált státusz alapján – értékeli, jelöli ki, jelenti be és követi nyomon.
summary_claims.literal_translation: § 4 (1) The conformity assessment bodies that check compliance with the requirements laid down in Chapter III Section 2 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in relation to high-risk AI systems shall be assessed, designated, notified and monitored by the AI notifying authority, on the basis of accredited status.

summary_claims.claim: an AI market surveillance authority with general competence that also runs the national AI regulatory sandbox and acts as the single point of contact
summary_claims.original_quote: (2) Az MI piacfelügyeleti hatóság a 10. § szerinti MI szabályozói tesztkörnyezetet működtet. (3) Az MI piacfelügyeleti hatóság országos illetékességgel ellátja az (EU) 2024/1689 európai parlamenti és tanácsi rendelet 70. cikke szerinti egyedüli kapcsolattartó pont működtetésével [...]
summary_claims.literal_translation: (2) The AI market surveillance authority operates the AI regulatory sandbox under § 10. (3) The AI market surveillance authority, with nationwide competence, performs the tasks of operating the single point of contact under Article 70 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. [5. § (1): it acts ex officio as a market surveillance authority of general competence.]

summary_claims.claim: creates the Hungarian Artificial Intelligence Council, an advisory body without decision-making powers chaired by a Prime Minister's appointee
summary_claims.original_quote: 8. § (1) A Magyar Mesterséges Intelligencia Tanács (a továbbiakban: Tanács) testületként működő, ügydöntő jogkörrel nem rendelkező szerv, amely [...] (2) A Tanács elnökét a miniszter és az informatikáért felelős miniszter javaslatára a miniszterelnök nevezi ki, 5 éves időtartamra.
summary_claims.literal_translation: § 8 (1) The Hungarian Artificial Intelligence Council (hereinafter: Council) is a body operating as a collegial body without decision-making competence, which [...] § 9 (2) The chair of the Council is appointed by the Prime Minister, on the proposal of the minister and the minister responsible for informatics, for a term of 5 years.

key_terms.note: Matches the AI Act's English 'notifying authority' (Art. 28), which § 3 cites.

'advisory body' in the summary renders 'ügydöntő jogkörrel nem rendelkező szerv' (body without decision-making competence); defensible, though the Council also issues recommendations and guidelines and coordinates AI Act implementation.

issues: document-1.pdf (also stored for HU-02) is the njt site's accessibility statement, not a source for the Act.
Nuance not in the summary: 5. § (1) excludes from the market surveillance authority's remit the financial entities supervised by the Magyar Nemzeti Bank (AI Act Art. 74(6)).
note: 'calls for a national AI strategy' is loose: 8. § (1) o) tasks the Council with drafting and continuously reviewing the national AI strategy and a sub-strategy for government bodies.
